Where the account an internal contact names reads its mail

directory_mailboxes.Rd

The access message of a row whose contact is internal does not go to that contact. By decision 12 it is the UPN, and for most accounts of the tenant the UPN has no mailbox behind it: Exchange Online refuses the message, and from then on the mail service suppresses the address and drops every later send to it in silence, after the person has been given a mailbox too. Decided on 2026-11-10: the message goes to two candidates instead, both read here from the sweep the round has already made, with no call of its own.

Usage

directory_mailboxes(directory, upns, domain = "ubep.unipd.it")

Arguments

directory

A directory frame as directory_users() returns.

upns

The UPN each row resolved to, as the resolution answered it. A name that is not an account of the tenant, as a collision's proposal, gets two empty strings.

domain

The tenant's verified domain, as identity_internal() takes it.

Value

A data frame with mailbox and external, one row per UPN: mailbox trimmed and otherwise as the directory writes it, external as directory_address() reads it.

Details

mailbox is the account's mail, when it carries one: Exchange writes the primary address there when it gives the account a mailbox, and on about 6.400 of the 7.700 accounts it is empty. The UPN does not count as one.

external is the first address the account carries outside the domain: the first of otherMails, otherwise officeLocation, the historical carrier of decision 9, which on many accounts holds a room instead. Each is read with directory_address(), which takes punctuation off its ends and keeps it only when what is left has the strict form of an address; one that does not is skipped for the next. An alias in the domain is skipped too, being the same mailbox or none.
